One flat panel is retained. Seating planes are independent design parameters; drawing domain boxes is not a PCB edge or qualified cavity.
99 capless 6 mm Bourns shafts; 12 x 12 mm pot boxes are provisional. Selected OCT body 16.2 x 18.5 mm, 8 mm unqualified cap envelope.
All 180 jacks above one divider; all controls below. Black/gold/white and black IN/red OUT hardware intentions are unchanged.
Ordinary PCB assembly must include every connector half. Direct inter-board soldering is not presumed available; final assembly has no home soldering.

No default inter-module signal connections. Power reuse unchanged. Source photograph demonstrates a construction concept, not exact dimensions of our parts.
